entities.summary: Charles Patrick Pfarrer III is an American writer, film producer, and former U.S. Navy SEAL. As an author, he has penned published screenplays, novels, comic books, and non-fiction works. His notable film credits include Navy SEALs (1990), Darkman (1990), Hard Target (1993), and Virus (1999).
